name: Mushroom Kurma
steps: Blend coconut, cashews, fennel, green chili and 120 ml water into a smooth kurma paste. Wipe mushrooms clean and quarter them.
Heat coconut oil and fry curry leaves briefly. Add onions and sauté 7 minutes until lightly golden; add ginger-garlic paste for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes, turmeric and salt. Cook 6 minutes, pressing the tomatoes until soft and thick.
Add mushrooms and stir-fry 5 minutes until they release moisture. Stir in the coconut-cashew paste and remaining water, then simmer gently 8 minutes until mushrooms are tender.
Taste for salt and rest 3 minutes before serving with chapati, appam or rice.
tips: Do not soak mushrooms in water; wipe them clean so the kurma stays rich instead of watery.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
